role: Public control surface of VoiceConversationController: toggle/start/stop/interrupt, AI interjection streaming for workout prompts, spoken trigger handling with routine/urgent preemption and a capped pending-trigger queue; plus InterjectionGate, the consent gate for automatic AI lines.
types: InterjectionGate: enum — static maySend consent/enablement gate
state: clipboard: UIPasteboard.general via PasteboardWriter (urgent-trigger dictation save)
mem:VoiceConversationController.assistantObservers (also holds the one-shot typed-reply drain observer while voice is idle)

units.does: Toggle from the talk button: idle → start(); listening → finalize the turn; speaking/thinking → interrupt; starting/triggerSpeaking → ignored.
units.entry: Voice buttons: AssistantChatView.swift:204, FitnessRecordingView+Tiles.swift:696, and EmuquApp.swift:750 (Watch voice tap)

branches.effect: break: tap ignored while a coach alert plays

units.does: Starts a voice session: only from .idle, flips to .starting, clears permissionError, awaits mic+speech permissions, returns to idle (playing any trigger queued while starting) on denial, bails if state changed meanwhile, then clears transcript/response, refreshes language/voice, pins the STT provider, resets the announce flag and opens the mic. Coach triggers arriving while .starting are queued (handleTrigger), so they can no longer take over the state mid-start.

branches.effect: return silently: stop() moved state during the prompt

units.does: Reads preferredSTTProvider, resolves effective provider (WhisperKit falls back to Apple for non-English), stores useWhisperKitForCurrentSession, and if WhisperKit, prepares its model and resets its buffers.

Configures/activates the voice audio session, installs the interruption observer and launches openFirstTurn in a Task (first user turn, then the start chime, then queued triggers). On a thrown error releases the coordinator's .voice claim (registered before setActive), sets a localized permissionError and returns to idle (returnToIdleAfterFailedStart).

branches.effect: logs error, releases the .voice claim, permissionError='Couldn't start the mic: …', back to idle

units.does: A start that never opened the mic: sets .idle and plays any trigger queued while voice was starting.

Awaits beginUserTurn; plays the haptic + Tink start cue only if voice is then listening (the recognizer is live when the user starts talking; a failed or ended start plays none); then drains any coach trigger queued while voice was starting.

Full teardown: sets isStoppingFully for the duration, cancels the interjection llmTask, cancels the chat stream only when voice owns it (cancelVoiceOwnedReply; a typed reply keeps streaming), drops queued coach triggers, drops observers, resets cursor, stops TTS, removes the interruption observer, tears down audio, releases STT, returns to .idle and clears transcript/response/chunker/preemptedState.
units.entry: AssistantChatView.swift:485, FitnessRecordingView+Tiles.swift:681; internally from beginUserTurn failure/idle (Pipeline:402,408), audio interruption ended (Audio:87), empty-transcript give-up (Audio:332) and consent-required (Audio:521)

units.does: Cancels the shared chat stream (AssistantViewModel.cancel) only when voice owns it: voice is speaking a reply (activeAssistantIndex set) or a voice message is queued behind the stream. Otherwise only stops speech (stopAnyOngoingSpeech), leaving a typed reply and its queued follow-up alone.

branches.cond: voice speaking a reply OR a voice send queued

units.does: Resets WhisperKit buffers if this session used WhisperKit and clears the session STT pin.

User/barge-in interrupt: cancels the interjection task and the shared assistant stream with isStoppingFully set around the cancel (so the re-entrant stopAnyOngoingSpeech schedules no second listening restart), drops observers, bumps responseSpeakGeneration, stops TTS, clears response/chunker/partial transcript, and launches beginUserTurn as the only restart.
Entry for AI interjection prompts (workout start readout, post-workout summary): queues an .aiPrompt (queueTrigger) while voice is starting or the user/AI is busy; otherwise plays it now.
True while voice is .starting (any urgency: its audio isn't set up and preempting would abandon the start) or, for a routine trigger, while isBusyWithUserResponse.

Enqueues the trigger on pendingTriggers (VoiceTriggerQueue.enqueue, which drops the oldest beyond 8 and the drop is logged as a warning), logs the queue size; with voice idle (the only wait is a typed reply streaming) arms drainWhenTypedReplyEnds so the queue drains when that reply finishes.

While no assistant observer is registered, registers one ObservationLoop on the chat's isStreaming; when it turns false with voice still idle, the observer cancels itself (cancelAssistantObservers) and drains the queue. Voice starting cancels it with the other assistant observers.
units.entry: Observation change delivery for the registered loop.

branches.cond: stream still running or voice not idle
branches.effect: ignore this change; else cancel observer and drain

units.does: Preempts for an AI interjection (preemptForTrigger), clears the response text and chunker, and starts the interjection stream.

Checks InterjectionGate for the active provider; if allowed sends a single-turn prompt with the context snapshot and the voice-coach system prompt to provider.send, stamps ttsStartedAt, and replaces llmTask with a task consuming the stream.

branches.cond: gate denies (AI off/notice not accepted/provider lacks consent)

units.does: Runs drainInterjection; any thrown stream error routes to finishInterjectionAfterError (silently, no user message).

branches.effect: error discarded; finishInterjectionAfterError restores pre-trigger state

units.does: Iterates the interjection stream applying each event; stops if the task is cancelled; if the stream closes without .done and the task is still current, finishes the interjection.

branches.effect: return immediately, nothing finalized (caller cancelled it)

branches.cond: not cancelled and llmTask != nil after stream end
branches.effect: finishInterjection(); if .done already ran llmTask is nil and this is skipped

units.does: Dispatches an interjection stream event: textDelta → ingest, done → finish, toolUse/usage ignored.
Appends delta to currentResponseText and speaks any complete sentence the chunker emits.

Speaks the chunker remainder, records the scrubbed full interjection text as lastInterjectionText, clears llmTask, and if still in .triggerSpeaking with nothing speaking, finishes the trigger immediately.

branches.effect: finishTriggerSpeech now; otherwise the didFinish delegate does it

units.does: Interjection failure/skip: clears llmTask; when triggers are queued and nobody is busy, plays the next one (keeping the pre-trigger snapshot, as finishTriggerSpeech does); otherwise restores the pre-trigger state — reopens the mic via beginUserTurn if it was listening/speaking, else sets .idle.

Routes a spoken coach trigger: queued (queueTrigger) while voice is starting, or for a routine trigger while the user/AI is busy; otherwise an urgent trigger first saves in-progress dictation to the clipboard, and the line plays now.
Copies trimmed partialTranscript to the clipboard via PasteboardWriter (localOnly policy) when non-empty.
True when an interjection llmTask exists, the shared view model is streaming, or the synth is speaking in .speaking.

branches.effect: true (also true for a typed-chat stream with voice idle)

units.does: Preempts with a literal trigger line (preemptForTrigger) and speaks the message in the app-language voice as scripted.

Common trigger preemption: snapshots preemptedState once; when voice was speaking a chat reply, detaches from it (detachFromSpokenReply) so the reply stops feeding speech; cancels the interjection task, stops TTS, kills the silence timer, starts a fresh recognition task only when the mic is live (not idle/starting), clears partialTranscript and sets .triggerSpeaking.

branches.effect: snapshot state; else keep earlier snapshot

units.does: Stops voice speaking the chat reply in progress: bumps responseSpeakGeneration (in-flight observation callbacks no-op), cancels the assistant observers, clears the active index and spoken cursor, resets the chunker. The reply keeps streaming into the chat; after the alert voice listens again.
Delegates to VoiceTurnPolicy.isBusyWithUserResponse with state, llmTask presence, view-model streaming, synth speaking and non-empty partial transcript.
Plays the next queued trigger (popFirst) if the queue is non-empty and nothing is busy.
Returns true only if Flo is allowed (AssistantViewModel.aiIsAllowed with disclaimer) and the provider does not require data-sharing consent; logs the skip reason.
